sections.needDataTitle: I am looking for more data
sections.needDataBody: I need more data to improve win-rate and metrics accuracy. You can help grow the database by sending your results or by registering and uploading them.
sections.contributeBody: You can open an Issue or submit a Pull Request to help improve this site, or create an account and start submitting your game data.
sections.winrateBody: (Game one wins + first side game wins + second side game wins) / total games played. A draw keeps the win rate at 50%. The sum of win rate A vs B and win rate B vs A should be 100%.
sections.tiersBody: Archetypes above 55% are Tier 1, between 50% and 55% are Tier 2, below 50% are Tier 3.

trio.intro: Insert the decks you want to use for your next Team Trio and verify whether the lists are compatible. Remember that you cannot use cards that are not legal in Pauper and you cannot use the same card in two different decks, not even one copy.
trio.details: How often have you been unsure about which cards are already shared between decks and had to spread all cards again to check duplicates? You can now use this quick utility to verify there are no shared cards among your decks. Save deck links for your teammates so you can re-check updated lists simply by reloading this page.
